Welcome to my portfolio for **MUSA 5080: Public Policy Analytics** at the

## About Me

<!-- CHANGE THIS: two or three sentences about yourself -->

I'm a student in the MUSA program at Penn. My background is in
Environmental Science and Data Science, and I'm interested in using geospatial
environmental data to create visualizations that help promote preservation of
natural spaces. I enjoy boardgames, golfing, playing volleyball, and cooking.
